metadata.title: How to Find Favorite Songs in Melivra | Android Screenshot Guide
metadata.description:
To find favorite songs in Melivra, open Lists and look under Smart Playlists for Favorite Songs. The same screen includes 5-Star Songs and 4-5 Star Songs.

Still-screen guide using real Android app screenshots with an original demonstration library. No taps, playback, file import, save result, or speed demonstration is shown.

Explore Melivra for Android:
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onnellab.melivra
